errors.evidence: The chart does not have an explicit x-axis label. The description invents the label "关键词数量" (Number of keywords).
The y-axis ticks are at 30, 44, 58, 72, 86, and 100, which represents an interval of 14, not 10.
The visible numerical range on the y-axis is from 30 to 100, not 0 to 100.
The term "柱状线" (bar lines) is awkward and not standard terminology for a bar chart. A clearer term would be "柱状图" (bars) or describing them as bar series.

errors.evidence: The data labels with the exact values are placed inside the bars, not always at the top of the bars.
The description fails to mention the grouped structure of the bar chart, which is a key visual feature for comparing the models within each category.
